rationale: The Lean target faithfully formalizes the finite real-matrix specialization of the displayed three-by-three inverse identity, including every sign, block position, both inverse products, and exact extraction of A*B. The selected PDF evidence also includes the immediately following complexity-preserving reduction from an exact inversion routine to exact multiplication. That content is absent: the target has no routine, omega or eta, big-O bound, arithmetic-operation model, 3n dimension-cost argument, or returned inverse. Moreover, its candidate inverse is defined using A*B, so it cannot itself encode the paper's computational reduction. The paper therefore implies the Lean algebraic proposition, but the Lean proposition does not imply the selected paper result. The result is nonvacuous but not-faithful-weaker.
